status: logic-bug correction after initial automated report
reason: The user explicitly required mutation as a retained baseline and referred to EvidenceScore, degree and other simple baselines. The first decision implementation accidentally omitted mutation when taking the strongest simple baseline.
correction: The strongest simple baseline is the maximum of mutation, EvidenceScore, PPI degree and GRN degree. No threshold, ranking, seed, candidate or external-evidence definition changed.
effect_on_initial_automated_decision: retain_bandit changed from true to false because mutation Top-150 independent-evidence hit rate was 0.420 and the best bandit profile was 0.360.
posthoc_sensitivity: A non-mutation external-evidence union is reported only to diagnose whether CPTAC mutation recurrence drives the primary result. It is not used to reverse or replace the frozen primary decision.
